title: Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst
description:
Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Denver, CO looking to add a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to their team. The role is a CONTRACT position.

Responsibilities
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance standards, processes, and testing methodologies.
  • Create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios based on business and functional requirements.
  • Execute manual and automated testing to validate new applications, enhancements, system integrations, and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solutions.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, user acceptance, and load testing as needed.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify software defects, configuration issues, and interoperability problems.
  • Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project teams to ensure quality is built into every stage of the software development lifecycle.
  • Analyze application requirements and technical documentation to develop effective testing strategies.
  • Recommend and implement opportunities for test automation using appropriate testing tools and frameworks.
  • Evaluate test results and provide recommendations regarding application quality and production readiness.
  • Monitor testing progress and communicate status, risks, and results to project stakeholders.
  • Review existing applications and testing processes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support release management activities by providing quality metrics and defect reporting.
  • Mentor junior QA team members through peer reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining change management processes, testing standards, and QA best practices.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and Tier III support for production issues when necessary.
  • Contribute to knowledge management by documenting testing procedures, lessons learned, and technical solutions.
  • Participate in team meetings, training, and other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
  • Equivalent combinations of education and relevant work experience will be considered.
  • Experience creating test plans, test cases, and test scripts from business and functional requirements.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software testing methodologies.
  • Experience testing both custom-developed applications and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software.
  • Hands-on experience with manual testing and automated testing tools.
  • Experience performing regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience tracking and managing software defects using defect management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
